title: AGY_CAUSAL_CLAIM_MANIFEST_V1
description: Machine-readable output contract shared by audit_agy_auth_surface.py and check_agy_causal_claim_drift.py (Issue #1778). Both scripts audit the AGY (Antigravity CLI) provider integration for undocumented authentication surface exposure and stale causal-claim code comments, and emit findings in this shape so downstream consumers can diff/aggregate them without per-producer parsing.

producer.description: Which of the two Issue #1778 scripts emitted this manifest.

target_files.description: Repo-relative paths of the source file(s) that were statically analyzed to produce findings.

status.description: Overall result. check_agy_causal_claim_drift.py fail-closes (non-zero exit) whenever status is findings_detected and any finding has severity p0.

baseline_applied.description: Issue #1788: present only when producer is check_agy_causal_claim_drift. True when invoked with --apply-baseline (CI gate baseline/allowlist mode); false for a plain invocation. Absent for audit_agy_auth_surface (no baseline concept).

baseline_count.description: Issue #1788: present only when baseline_applied is true. Count of findings whose stable identity matched the built-in CI-gate baseline (pre-existing, non-blocking).

new_finding_count.description: Issue #1788: present only when baseline_applied is true. Count of findings NOT in the baseline; a non-zero value here (with severity p0) is what causes the --apply-baseline invocation to fail closed.

finding_id.description: Stable, deterministic identifier for this finding (e.g. "auth_surface:agy_oauth_token_path").

identifier.description: The surface name, function name, or Issue reference this finding is about.

rationale_present.description: auth_surface findings only: whether a nearby comment documents the necessity of exposing this surface.

source_file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding's evidence line lives in.

line.description: 1-based line number of the finding's primary evidence in source_file.

issue_number.description: causal_claim_drift findings only: the Issue #N referenced by the code comment.

doc_path.description: causal_claim_drift findings only: the references/*.md document whose status contradicts the code comment.

doc_status.description: causal_claim_drift findings only: the frontmatter status value found in doc_path.
